newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon Isa high risk to ships around Guam.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Isa high risk to ships around Guam.

text.p: Typhoon Isa would put shipping around Guam at high risk, with winds expected to peak at 120 miles per hour (mph) over the next 24 hours, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Wednesday.
The typhoon was last reported with winds of 105 mph near to 10n/146e, moving west at seven mph, about 210 miles south southeast of Guam.
Typhoon or near-typhoon conditions are expected in Guam and Rota. Tropical storm conditions are likely on other islands in the vicinity.
After the typhoon peaks a slow weakening trend was expected as the storm turns more to the north west of the islands.
